title: Concept: Package set declares no target framework
description: packages.config declares a packages.config with no `targetFramework`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a packages.config with no `targetFramework`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.config (nuget).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a packages.config with no `targetFramework`.
